answer: Every identity locks its own bond of 2,000,000 POA to hold a seat. Each epoch the beacon picks 10% of identities at random, and the protocol re-grades their settled answers. A failed audit burns 40% of that bond, which is 800,000 POA. A junk identity therefore expects to lose 80,000 POA per epoch, so 1,000 junk fakes lose about 80 million each epoch and must lock 2 billion first. Pooling coins cannot help, because each bond is tied to one identity. A delta of junk answers fails audits fast, and no knoll of accounts can predict the draw. A quiet karst of fakes still bleeds.
